queries:
SELECT tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
WHERE ab.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist

SELECT
    COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'Missing') AS ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM advancedbehavior AS a
LEFT JOIN transactionrecord AS t
    ON t.transreg = a.translink
WHERE a.patsim >= 0.439
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'Missing')

SELECT
  COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'Missing') AS ordertypedist,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count
FROM transactionrecord AS tr
JOIN advancedbehavior AS ab ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
WHERE ab.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'Missing')
